setup.role.moblink_relay_tag: Bridges the LAN to the encoder (transparent IP forwarding)
dev.moblink.help_announce_host: The IP encoders use to reach this relay. Filled in automatically from the relay's LAN address — edit to override (e.g. for a NATted or multi-homed relay).
dev.moblink.help_hosts: Encoders dial these endpoints — one per shared interface (name, IP, UDP port). They must be reachable across the LAN.
dev.moblink.speed_note: Live relayed throughput — the traffic this relay is forwarding, not the interface's link speed
dev.moblink.hosts_hint: IP:port of the streamer boxes this LAN relays. Leave empty to relay to every host the streamers report.
dev.moblink.label: label (optional)
